stories.headline: Trafigura Warns Oil at 'Inflection Point' as Iran War Drives Record $4B Profit
stories.thesis: The world's largest commodity trader says energy markets have reached a structural turning point. Gulf states are negotiating Hormuz bypass pipelines while US oil stocks hit 2004 lows — three converging signals that change the risk calculation on crude.

stories.headline: Americans Lead Global AI Data Centre Backlash, Poll Finds
stories.thesis: NIMBY opposition to AI infrastructure is rising even as Nvidia calms disruption fears. The contradiction between public sentiment and corporate capex acceleration is the real story — $55bn SpaceX plant exemptions, Meta WhatsApp AI agents, and Google's $85bn raise all push forward.

stories.headline: US Plans Cuts to NATO Rapid Response Force as Cable Sabotage Probes Expand
stories.thesis: America reduces NATO's quick-reaction capability at the same moment suspected deep-sea cable sabotage triggers the alliance's first collective response. The divergence between strategic posture and operational reality is widening.

stories.headline: Hungary Lifts 17-Month Veto on Ukraine's EU Membership Bid
stories.thesis: Orban's blockage of Ukraine's EU accession path collapses after 17 months. The Gulf states and Ukraine need each other — a realignment that exposes Europe's dependence on non-EU energy corridors.

stories.headline: Hurricane Trump Threatens to Blow China Off Course
stories.thesis: Trump's tariff escalation and Iran war are destabilizing China's growth model. A leading property developer reports huge losses as real-estate crisis widens. The PBOC faces a trilemma: stabilize the yuan, support growth, or manage trade war fallout.

stories.headline: Morgan Stanley Says Fed Is Discounting the Iran War in Rate Decisions
stories.thesis: The Fed is treating the Iran conflict as a transitory supply shock rather than a structural inflation driver. If Morgan Stanley is right that the war is being discounted, rate expectations will need a hard repricing when energy costs hit consumer prices.
